picks.title: Nvidia agrees to acquire Hugging Face for $13B
picks.why_it_matters: This massive acquisition consolidates AI infrastructure under Nvidia and signals that open-source ML tooling has become strategically critical, potentially reshaping which AI startups can compete independently.

picks.title: This former PG&E engineer is building a 'Google Maps for the underground'
picks.why_it_matters: A $26M Series A for infrastructure mapping software with clear founder-market fit highlights growing VC appetite for vertical B2B software solving unsexy but critical utility and construction pain points.

picks.title: Tech giants warn time is running out to prepare for AI threats
picks.why_it_matters: Coordinated warnings from OpenAI, Anthropic, and cloud giants about imminent AI-enabled cyberattacks signal an emerging category opportunity for startups building AI-native security tools.
